meta.name: extend-self-review
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "customize self-review", "change review types", "adjust confidence threshold", "add review types to self-review", or "configure the review orchestrator". Create or modify a self-review-extension skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制你的自我审查技能,调整审查类型与阈值
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想调整自我审查技能的分类和阈值
copy.tagline_en: Customize your self-review skill by adjusting review types and thresholds.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to tweak the types and thresholds used by your self-review skill.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求定制 self-review 时，Claude 会检查现有配置、展示默认设置，引导你选择修改项，并生成或更新对应的 SKILL.md 文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“定制 self-review”、“更改审查类型”、“调整置信度阈值”等请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我自定义 self-review，添加自定义审查类型。
say.note: Claude 会展示现有配置和可选类型，引导你选择。

say.text: 把置信度阈值从 80 改成 90。
say.note: 会调整默认的置信度门槛并更新配置。

say.text: 给 self-review 添加审查前运行构建和 lint 的步骤。
say.note: 这些操作会成为审查前的固定步骤。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask to customize self-review, Claude checks existing config, shows defaults, guides you through changes, and creates or updates the corresponding SKILL.md file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "customize self-review", "change review types", "adjust confidence threshold", etc.

say_en.text: Help me customize self-review and add a custom review type.
say_en.note: Claude shows current config and options, then guides your choices.

say_en.text: Change the confidence threshold from 80 to 90.
say_en.note: Updates the default threshold and writes the config.

say_en.text: Add a pre-review step that runs build and lint.
say_en.note: These commands become fixed pre-review actions.
